item.title: Construction starts on 272-unit apartment complex, part of a larger downtown development plan
item.description: It’s part of a wider project that’s expected to eventually bring 900 apartments and 50 new storefronts. The first building, called Portico, is slated to finish by June 2028. The post Construction starts on 272-unit apartment complex, part of a larger downtown development plan appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: The Melt, Luna Grill, Urbane Café coming to new restaurant space in East Long Beach
item.description: They'll move into a building that replaced the CVS at Seventh Street and Bellflower Boulevard. The post The Melt, Luna Grill, Urbane Café coming to new restaurant space in East Long Beach appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Long Beach City Council calls for impeachment of DHS Secretary Kristi Noem
item.description: The vote expressing their position comes as Long Beach's congressman is leading an investigation into Noem, hoping to build the case for her removal. The post Long Beach City Council calls for impeachment of DHS Secretary Kristi Noem appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Local officials press LA Olympics committee chair to resign over his ties to Epstein associate Ghislaine Maxwell
item.description: Long Beach’s state senator and LA County Supervisor Janice Hahn were among those saying Casey Wasserman should step down from the LA28 organizing committee. The post Local officials press LA Olympics committee chair to resign over his ties to Epstein associate Ghislaine Maxwell appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Supreme Court lets California use new Congressional maps designed to boost Democrats
item.description: Long Beach’s congressman is a key part of the plan. His district will absorb some Republican-heavy portions of Orange County to dilute their voting power. The post Supreme Court lets California use new Congressional maps designed to boost Democrats appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Botched gang ambush killed longtime street vendor, investigators testify in court hearing
item.description: They said four gunmen let off at least 25 rounds trying to shoot a rival they recognized from social media. Instead, one bullet hit an unintended target. The post Botched gang ambush killed longtime street vendor, investigators testify in court hearing appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: LBUSD may drop a year of math from graduation requirements. Personal finance, ethnic studies will be added.
item.description: The current four-year requirement means many students are in math classes they don’t want to be in and have no interest in passing, according to one math teacher. item.title: Thousands of mule deer will be killed on Catalina Island as part of restoration plan
